summary: Across from a newly dug channel at {place}, water can enter an old channel again.
realLife: The Fall City project reopened a side channel on the Snoqualmie’s left bank and built another on the right.
gates: A river restoration plan identifies an existing side channel.
weights: A higher inlet elevation makes the connection more dependent on high water.
inGame: needs: connections opened by a floodplain project.

turns.what: The old channel stays separated from the river.
turns.pulledBy: Engineers find that reopening it would threaten a neighboring road.
turns.writesBack: The approved plan removes that connection.

turns.what: The old channel reconnects only at high flows.
turns.pulledBy: The installed inlet sits above ordinary water level.
turns.writesBack: Monitoring records when water reaches the channel.
